title: Order present header fields as URN -> Tested-By -> Runtime -> Purpose

facts.note: Applies to any file checked by the Bun realization that carries a URN traceability field; needs a content scan for the URN, Tested-By, Runtime and Purpose fields. Not gated on edits, phase or prior findings.
Signal emitted by bun_green_traceability_detector when a present field appears before its predecessor; it confirms a violation but is not a precondition for the obligation.

fires: A Bun-checked file carries a URN field and its Tested-By field appears above the URN field.
A Bun-checked file has URN, Runtime and Purpose fields with Purpose written before Runtime, even if the header was not touched in the current change.
The detector reports a header-order finding on a file.
doesNotFire: A file with no URN field at all (nothing to order against).
A file whose header lacks Tested-By or Runtime but whose present fields are in canonical order (missing fields belong to their own rules).
A file whose present fields are in canonical order with other comment lines interleaved between them.

given: A file checked by the Bun realization carries a URN traceability field plus any of Tested-By, Runtime, Purpose
when: the file exists in the checked codebase, regardless of whether its header was edited in the current change
then: The present header fields MUST appear in the order URN -> Tested-By -> Runtime -> Purpose.
prefer: During GREEN repair: reorder only the header lines needed to restore the canonical sequence.
During GREEN repair: keep the existing field values unless another convention proves one is wrong.
During GREEN repair: preserve unrelated comments.
avoid: Do not broaden: rewriting identifiers, acceptance bindings, runtime, or purpose merely while fixing order.
Do not broaden: moving implementation code to satisfy a header-order finding.
Adding a missing field just to silence this rule — absence is each field's own rule, not this one.
unless: The file has no URN — it is skipped; there is nothing to order against.
A field is absent — it is not considered; presence is each field's own rule.
Other comment lines are interleaved between the fields — this is allowed.
why: A fixed order (identity, then proof, then execution context, then intent — each field answering the question the previous one raises) lets a reader, human or tool, know where to look without parsing; it is the same order in Python, Vite and Bun.
evidence: Prove: the present header fields appear in canonical order (bun_green_traceability_detector reports no GREEN-HEADER-004 / BUN-GREEN-HEADER-ORDER-001 finding).
Prove: the current behavioral acceptance still passes after the reorder.
The order fix touches only header lines and moves no implementation code; field values are unchanged except where another convention proves a value wrong.
verifier_detail: Canonical order: URN -> Tested-By -> Runtime -> Purpose.
Detector collects the line numbers of the fields that are present and reports the first field that appears before its predecessor.
Present field = a header field the file actually carries; absent fields are skipped so this rule never double-reports a missing field another rule owns.
Files with no URN are skipped entirely.
Non-field comment lines interleaved between fields are ignored.
